nodes.name: Scrape LinkedIn Jobs (RSS)
nodes.notes:
🔗 LINKEDIN RSS SCRAPER

⚠️ SETUP REQUIRED:
1. Go to: https://www.linkedin.com/jobs/
2. Search: 'Sales Development Representative India'
3. Apply filters (Remote, Mid-Level, etc.)
4. Copy the URL from address bar
5. Add '/feed' to the end
6. Paste here as Feed URL

Example:
https://www.linkedin.com/jobs/search/?keywords=SDR&location=India/feed

f_WT=2 means Remote jobs only

nodes.name: Scrape Indeed Jobs (RSS)
nodes.notes:
🔗 INDEED RSS SCRAPER

⚠️ SETUP REQUIRED:
1. Go to: https://www.indeed.co.in/
2. Search: 'BDR Bangalore'
3. Copy the URL
4. Change '/jobs?' to '/rss?'
5. Add '&fromage=7' for last 7 days only
6. Paste here as Feed URL

Example:
https://www.indeed.co.in/rss?q=SDR&l=Bangalore&fromage=7

nodes.name: Merge All Job Sources
nodes.notes:
🔀 MERGE NODE

Nothing to configure.
